title: His food initiative fed 30 million people during COVID. In 2026, TIME named him one of the 100 most influential people alive.

sources.text: India Currents - Chef Vikas Khanna Named To 2026 TIME100 List
The Tribune - Vikas Khanna makes it to the TIME 100 list

caption:
His food initiative fed 30 million people during COVID. In 2026, TIME named him one of the 100 most influential people alive.

Long before the recognition, Khanna - an 8-Michelin-star chef - redirected his career toward large-scale food relief, running the effort alongside his culinary and filmmaking work rather than as a side project.

He joins the list alongside fellow honorees Sundar Pichai and Ranbir Kapoor, recognized for a body of work that spans his humanitarian food-relief work, his directorial debut 'The Last Color,' and his Cannes-premiered documentary 'Kitchens of Gratitude.'

Khanna's recognition came from a decade of feeding people, not just cooking for them - a reminder that global influence and grassroots relief work aren't opposites.
